meta.description: Robustness corpus for documented technical-token and Unicode-preservation behavior
meta.notes: These cases lock existing conservative behavior: technical tokens and non-Arabic-letter controls pass through toSearchKey. They do not change any runtime rule. Arabic text is normalized only under the documented pipeline.

cases.name: URL with Arabic path and query is preserved
cases.notes: ASCII URL syntax and Arabic letters are preserved; ة is intentionally preserved by toSearchKey.

cases.name: Email address embedded in Arabic text is preserved
Windows path with Arabic segments is preserved
cases.notes: Backslashes, drive syntax, extension, and Arabic letters are preserved.

cases.name: Social handle with Arabic and ASCII digits is preserved
Non-BMP emoji is preserved beside Arabic text
cases.notes: Emoji is U+1F600; no normalization is applied to it.

cases.name: ZWJ and ZWNJ controls are preserved
cases.notes: U+200D/U+200C are format controls outside the Arabic letter normalization set.

cases.name: LRM and RLM controls are preserved
cases.notes: U+200E/U+200F are bidi controls outside the Arabic letter normalization set.

cases.name: Non-Arabic combining mark is preserved
cases.notes: U+0301 is a combining mark outside the documented Arabic tashkeel ranges.
